featured.name: Claude Design
featured.description: Anthropic's Claude Design: generate and iterate on UI designs and mockups from the agent.
featured.notes: Built into Claude Code: Claude sessions in Ruah have the Claude Design tool when your claude.ai account has Claude Design access. If it asks for design access, run /design login once in an interactive Claude Code session on this Mac. Its endpoint (api.anthropic.com/v1/design/mcp) accepts only Claude Code's own sign-in, so it cannot be added as an MCP server for other agents.

featured.name: Filesystem

featured.name: GitHub
featured.description: Issues, pull requests, code search and Actions through GitHub's official MCP server.
featured.notes: Needs Docker. Save a fine-grained personal access token as GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN (kept in the macOS Keychain). Hosted alternative: https://api.githubcopilot.com/mcp/ (OAuth, in agents that support remote MCP).
